surah.personality_title: At-Tin — The Sacred Sanctuaries & The Nobility of the Human Mould
surah.personality_summary: Geographical-spiritual, anthropological, judicial. Oaths by the Fig, Olive, Mount Sinai, and the Secure City of Mecca frame the ontological creation of humanity in the best of statures (Fi Ahsani Taqweem), followed by regression to the lowest of the low except for those anchored in faith and righteous works.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah At-Tin (The Fig) is the 95th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 8 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والتين والزيتون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the fig and the olive
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the fig, by the olive

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لقد خلقنا الانسان في احسن تقويم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: We have certainly created man in the best of stature
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We create man in the finest state

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We return him to the lowest of the low
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then reduce him to the lowest of the low

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات فلهم اجر غير ممنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: except those who believe and do good deeds––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will have an unfailing reward. After this, what makes you [man] deny the Judgement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is not Allah the most just of judges
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Is God not the most decisive of judges
